definitions.explanation: A student who is currently enrolled at a school. Used to distinguish current students from graduates (卒業生) or prospective students.

examples.japanese: {在校生|ざいこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{卒業生|そつぎょうせい}→卒業生：15284_sotsugyousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}り{出|だ}す→送り出す：06085_okuridasu⟧。
examples.english: The current students see off the graduates.

examples.japanese: {在校生|ざいこうせい}⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{送辞|そうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: The student representative read the farewell address.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{在校生|ざいこうせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{八百名|はっぴゃくめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{減少|げんしょう}している→減少する：19026_genshousuru⟧。
examples.english: This school has about 800 currently enrolled students, and the number is decreasing year by year.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {在校|ざいこう} (being enrolled at school) + {生|せい} (student). Commonly heard at graduation ceremonies, where {在校生|ざいこうせい} (current students) give a {送辞|そうじ} (farewell address) to the ⟦{卒業生|そつぎょうせい}→卒業生：15284_sotsugyousei⟧ (graduates).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {在校生|ざいこうせい}⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧ (student representative)
- {在校生|ざいこうせい}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number of enrolled students)
- {在校生|ざいこうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{送辞|そうじ} (farewell address by current students)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{卒業生|そつぎょうせい}→卒業生：15284_sotsugyousei⟧: graduate, alumnus — someone who has already graduated
- ⟦{新入生|しんにゅうせい}→新入生：03073_shinnyuusei⟧: new student — a freshly enrolled student
